rules.text: Unverified sessions are refused access to sensitive account, card, and transaction details and cannot perform modifications.
Monetary amounts are stored and processed strictly as integer minor units (cents) with ISO currency codes.
Card lock and dispute creations are idempotent; duplicate lock or dispute submissions for the same entity or request key return the existing record without duplicate side-effects.
Operations are strictly scoped to the authenticated customer; cross-customer record access or modification is refused.
Customer verification challenge method and attempt limits.
Policy governing which transactions can be disputed based on status and age.
Allowed dispute category reasons accepted by the bank.
Enforce customer confirmation requirement before locking a card.
Maximum retry limit for transient service calls.
The agent must verify the customer's identity before disclosing sensitive card, account, or transaction details.
The agent must ask for and receive explicit customer confirmation before locking a payment card.
The agent must explain bank dispute policy and decline filing disputes on pending transactions when policy forbids it.
The agent must provide the dispute case ID and describe clear next steps after filing or looking up a dispute.
The agent must offer a secure specialist handoff when customer verification fails or service errors occur.
